messages:
Jon: Promo paused by deploy-bot. Several staging runners failing where tar reports unexpected EOF when extracting the service wheel. DeployBot created a hold.

DeployBot: Promotion paused by deploy-bot at 3444445555. Reason: artifact-extract-eof on staging-service. See https://ci.redwood/builds/19821 :no_entry_sign:

Yuki: Log snippet from runner-14:
```
ERROR tar: unexpected EOF
failed to extract /tmp/artifacts/service-2.4.0-py3-none-any.whl: truncated file (expected 2048000, got 1536000)
GET s3://redwood-ci-wheels/2026/03/22/wheels/19821.part returned Content-Length 2048000 but body shorter
```

storage-bot: Observability: spike in S3 5xxs in us-east-1 around 16:12 UTC. Storage ticket ST-1518 opened and assigned.

Jon: Options: (A) pin staging to last-good digest to unblock the change window (~25m left), (B) re-upload wheel and invalidate cache then verify (might take 10-18m), (C) attempt cache purge (uncertain). Thoughts?

Yuki: Fastest is pin. I can trigger re-upload in background with a new cache key and `VERIFY_UPLOAD=1`. If reupload succeeds we'll retarget the canary.

CI-Runner-Bot: queued command: `/ci retry builds/19821 --only artifacts` (3 jobs).

oncall-sre: If we pin, ensure release notes are annotated and a rollback playbook is added. Also temporarily raise alert sensitivity for `artifact.extract.errors`.

Jon: Manual promote API: `/deploy promote --env=staging --service=staging-service --digest=sha256:abcd1234 --reason="pin known-good to meet change window"` (requires two approvals).

Yuki: +1. I'll start the reupload with `CACHE_KEY_SUFFIX=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)` and `VERIFY_UPLOAD=1`.

oncall-sre: +1

DeployBot: Promote executed: staging-service -> sha256:abcd1234 at 3444445661. Comment: pinned to known-good image to unblock release.

Yuki: Reupload started, checksums verified locally. Triggering verify job with `NO_CACHE=1`. Link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/verify-2211

CI-Runner-Bot: verify-2211 started on runners 4, 9, 14.

Jon: Timeline: pin T+0, verify expected T+6m, retarget T+15m if green. If verification fails, we'll keep pin and escalate storage team.

storage-bot: Storage team will run integrity sweep on recent uploads and disable any suspect edge node. Ticket ST-1518 updated.

CI-Runner-Bot: verify-2211 passed on all runners.

Yuki: Verified green. Planning retarget to new digest after a 5m smoke. Will remove pin once propagation confirmed.

Jon: Unblock confirmed. Postmortem owners: Yuki (artifact pipeline), storage-team (edge cache). I'll add release note entry: "Temporary pin to known-good image due to truncated artifact downloads; retarget after verified reupload. See ST-1518." Thanks team. :raised_hands:
